ValidationRule.description: Que no permita eliminar el Product Specialist cuando la oportunidad vinculada esté en una fase que no sea Draft Opp
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, 'Draft Opp')), ISBLANK(DES_Product_Specialist__c), NOT(ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE(DES_Product_Specialist__c))), NOT( ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sorry, you can't do this yet. You can't delete the Product Specialist in this Stage.
